integrity: The proof is analytic. The included finite computation checks only the exact strict-extension example and numerically corroborates the quadratic maximization; it is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordered full-rank two-qubit spectra satisfying \(2\lambda_2+\lambda_3<\lambda_1\).
The envelope is necessary for the specified non-entangling conversion, not sufficient.
The result does not classify all remaining full-rank spectra.
title: An exact continuum envelope for the full-rank fixed-spectrum entanglement no-go
